body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range after moving up to 1 unit.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to 1 unit through existing concealment. On success, deal 2 weapon Damage.

surges.html: Deal +1 Damage if you were Hidden from the target when this Action was declared; attacking reveals you.

rider.title: Contingency - Ambush
rider.html: When that target misses an Action before your next turn, you may move 2 units toward concealment without triggering its movement Reactions.
